raw.rationale: NMS-1286937 is a PLK1 inhibitor with additional FLT3 activity, and PLK1 inhibition preferentially kills rapidly dividing cells with high mitotic index; PRISM single-concentration screens show most compounds are selective for no lineage, with only modest enrichment in proliferative lineages such as lung, breast, and colorectal. FLT3 amplification/activation is rare outside AML, so lineage selectivity is unlikely beyond weak general cytotoxicity patterns.
